name: Cannalope Jeeter XL Infused Pre-Roll | 2g
description: Introducing, Cannalope! This indica-leaning phenotype will take you on a tropical journey with its refreshing and exotic flavors. Cannalope boasts a juicy melon and tropical fruit flavor on the inhale, followed by a satisfying exhale of pine and spices that come from its kush lineage. Its deeply relaxing effects and light physical tingles make it the perfect strain for unwinding and enjoying a laid-back island vibe any time of year.
